name: Chicken Pot Pies (Hand-Held)
desc: Refrigerated biscuits folded around a creamy canned chicken and vegetable filling and baked until golden.

source.title: Easy Hand-Held Chicken Pot Pies
source.evidence: Same method and core list: frozen mixed vegetables microwaved with 2 tbsp water, onion, canned chicken, cream of chicken soup, and two cans of Grands biscuits folded and baked at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz) cans chunk chicken breast, drained
1 (10.5 oz) can condensed cream of chicken soup
2 (16.3 oz) cans refrigerated biscuits, 8 count each (16 biscuits)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray.
Put the frozen vegetables and water in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave until warmed through, 1 to 3 minutes. Drain.
Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables, chicken, soup, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and everything bagel seasoning. Cook and stir until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Flatten each biscuit into a 5-inch circle with your fingertips. Spoon about 1/4 cup filling onto one half, fold the other half over, and press the edges with a fork to seal.
Set the pies on the baking sheet and bake until deep golden on top and bottom, 30 to 35 minutes.
tips: Keep the filling off the edges of the dough or the seams will not seal and the filling will leak.

references.title: Easy Hand-Held Chicken Pot Pies
